reason: My main Instagram is my storefront and my proof, and this wants to send automated DMs from it with zero customer results shown. $147 is nothing to me, but I'm not putting the account on the line for a tool nobody has proven yet.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell, and one flagged or restricted account costs me months of content and clients. 'No customer results published yet' plus a '7 of 100 seats' push makes it feel like a pitch, not proof.
would_change_my_mind: Real agency owners showing before/after reply and booked-call numbers from cold DMs on their own main accounts, with no restrictions after a few months, plus a way to run it on a secondary account first.
